key_information_units.information: 2025 full-year headline financial performance: revenue increased 40% to DKK 126.5m, EBITDA increased 26% to DKK 31.1m, and EBT increased 109% to DKK 19.0m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue increased by 40% to DKK 126,523k (2024: DKK 90,070k); EBITDA increased by 26% to DKK 31,117k (2024: DKK 24,671k); EBT reached DKK 19,013k (2024: DKK 9,068k), a 109% increase.

key_information_units.information: Record Q4 2025 performance with revenue of DKK 41.0m (+106% YoY), EBITDA of DKK 13.8m, and EBT of DKK 10.1m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Q4 revenue reached DKK 40,959k (2024: DKK 19,924k), a 106% increase; EBITDA 13,788k; Profit before tax (EBT) 10,120k.

key_information_units.information: Strategic optimisation of in-app advertising (IAA) leading to 100% growth in IAA revenue to DKK 18.5m (14.6% of total revenue).
key_information_units.source_evidence: In-App Ads (IAA) revenue surged to DKK 18,476k (2024: DKK 9,226k), a 100% increase; advertising revenue accounted for 14.6% in 2025 following late-September optimisation program.

key_information_units.information: Transport Series 'Big 3' titles (Airline Manager, Truck Manager, Farm Manager) generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA (DKK 20m).
key_information_units.source_evidence: These three games generated 67% of our 2025 revenue, corresponding to DKK 85m (2024: DKK 31m), and 65% of EBITDA amounting to DKK 20m (2024: DKK 9m).

key_information_units.information: Successful launch of Farm Manager in July 2025 (following 5m pre-registrations) contributing DKK 22.0m revenue in first six months.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Farm Manager launched in July 2025... contributed DKK 22,002k in its first six months... propelled by five million pre-registrations.

key_information_units.information: Truck Manager scaling to DKK 25.2m revenue in its first full year, with foundational improvements and ad-revenue features.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Truck Manager... revenue increasing to DKK 25,181k (2024: DKK 1,216k)... introduction of a detailed staff management system and Long Hauls... pilot for our revamped ad-revenue strategy.

key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance: revenue DKK 130-153m (3%-21% growth), EBITDA DKK 28-36m, EBT DKK 18-24m, supported by marketing budget of DKK 45-50m and ad income of DKK 22-27m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: For the 2026 financial year, the company expects: Revenue 130-153m... EBITDA 28-36m... EBT 18-24m... marketing budget of DKK 45m-50m... Projected ad income of DKK 22m-27m.

key_information_units.information: Advancement of product pipeline including pre-production of Train Manager 2 and development start for Space Manager, plus premium PC title The Ranchers.
key_information_units.source_evidence: We are currently in pre-production for Train Manager 2... Space Manager... development officially beginning in December 2025... The premium PC title, The Ranchers, is progressing well.

key_information_units.information: Robust capital structure with 78% solvency ratio, DKK 66.1m total equity, zero interest-bearing external debt, and completion of DKK 4.9m share buyback program (3.87% treasury shares).
key_information_units.source_evidence: strong solvency ratio of 78% (2024: 86%)... total equity increased to DKK 66,120k... no interest-bearing external debt... share buy-back program totaling DKK 4,894k... holds 3.87% in treasury shares.
